Advanced Diploma in Insurance (ACII) with at least six (06) years of experience in general insurance/reinsurance companies, Takaful operators, and/or insurance/reinsurance brokers. jobs.title: Senior Assistant Staff
jobs.description:
Eligible Qualification & Experience:
Sixteen (16) years of Education in relevant field with three (03) years post qualification relevant experience.
OR
Fourteen (14) years of Education in relevant field with five (05) years post qualification relevant experience.
Candidate having the following skills and experience will be preferred:
Handling of official record and correspondence
Basic awareness of telecom and networking concepts
Familiarity with concepts of software or application usage.
Willingness to support routine system operations and follow standard procedures
Basic skills in researching technical information using manuals, internal documentation, and online resources.
Basic Working knowledge of Microsoft Office products
Terms and Conditions
This position is on contract basis for an initial period of three years, extendable based on performance and business needs.
Applications should be submitted to https://njp.gov.pk/
Copies of degrees, transcripts, CNIC, experience certificates and Domicile Certificate are to be submitted along-with the application.
The required maximum age limit is 40 years; however, all candidates will be allowed an upper age relaxation of five (05) years only for this special exercise.
Candidates must apply for the job within 15 days of the date of this advertisement.
Only short-listed candidates will be contacted for next stage of the recruitment process.
Falsely reported information in application, resume or during the test/ interview(s) will result in cancellation of candidature or termination of the employment contract at any stage (as the case may be) without following any disciplinary proceedings.
No TA/DA will be admissible for test / interview.
The organization reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process for any or all of the positions at any time / stage.
Women/ Minorities and differently abled persons are encouraged to apply.
The selected Candidates can be posted in Balochistan.
Incomplete application or applications received after the closing date will not be entertained.
For technical assistance regarding the application process on the National Job Portal(NJP), applicants may contact the Helpdesk at 051-9265411 or 051-9265062

jobs.organization: Ministry of Federal Education and Professional Training
jobs.description:
Education/Qualification:
Matriculation.
Minimum typing speed of 30 w.p.m.
The selected candidate shall have to undertake and qualify for a 3-week Basic IT Training Course (including MS Office), conducted by the NITB, within one year.
Job Description/Duties:
A Lower Division Clerk (LDC) in the Government of Pakistan (typically, BPS-11) handles foundational clerical, administrative, and record-keeping duties within federal and provincial departments:
Key Responsibilities:
Typing and Documentation: Typing official letters, memos, notifications, reports, and routine correspondence.
Receipt and Dispatch: Receiving incoming mail, logging entries into the Section Diary and File Register, and dispatching outgoing correspondence.
File Management: Organizing, indexing, and maintaining physical and digital office files so documents are easy to retrieve.
Data Entry & Computer Work: Entering office data into spreadsheets or databases and operating basic office equipment (printers, scanners, and copiers).
Administrative Assistance: Assisting senior officers with routine paperwork, pulling reference files, and handling basic office workflow.
Job Location: Islamabad, Pakistan
Job Type: Regular
Domicile Quota: Balochistan
Gender: Both Male and Female
Only shortlisted Candidates will be allowed for walk-in interviews.
Recruitment will be done at the doorstep (at district level) with the help of newly established Employment Cells in the districts of Balochistan as a special case to ensure recruitment of residents.
